response.rationale: A and B are related but are different concepts. A, "Payment", is the payment transaction and its outcome for a booking. BookingService.handlePaymentResult takes a reference and a result of "paid" | "failed" | "refunded". B, "Payment Gateway", is the outside payment service. In the persistence/infrastructure layer, PuckPayClient implements the PuckPayGateway interface to reach it. One is a transaction and the other is the service that processes transactions, so they are not the same real-world thing.
